panels.title: Load (5 min) per core
panels.description: Above 1 means more work than cores.

panels.title: Disks healthy (SMART)
panels.description: smartctl's health verdict for disks that report SMART. This server is a VM, so its disk is virtual and has none; the physical disks are on the Proxmox hosts.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Every container on this host, from cAdvisor. A short 'Up for' means it restarted.

panels.title: Prometheus targets
panels.description: Everything Prometheus collects from. Proxmox (pve-exporter), UniFi (UnPoller) and the machines in deploy/monitoring/nodes.yml feed 'Other machines' below.

panels.title: Machines
panels.description: Empty until a machine is added to deploy/monitoring/nodes.yml (runbook 'Monitoring', 'Adding another machine'). Proxmox machines are on the Proxmox cluster dashboard.

targets.expr: (100 * (1 - avg by (instance, machine, role) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="machines",group!="proxmox",mode="idle"}[5m])))) or (100 * (1 - avg by (instance, machine, role) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job="machines",group!="proxmox",mode="idle"}[5m]))))

(max by (instance, machine, role) (100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox"}))) or (max by (instance, machine, role) (100 * (1 - windows_os_physical_memory_free_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox"} / windows_cs_physical_memory_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox"})))

(max by (instance, machine, role) (100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|rootfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|rootfs"}))) or (max by (instance, machine, role) (100 * (1 - windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job="machines",group!="proxmox"})))

max by (instance, machine, role) (time() - node_boot_time_seconds{job="machines",group!="proxmox"}) or max by (instance, machine, role) (windows_system_system_up_time{job="machines",group!="proxmox"})

panels.title: Home lab services
panels.description: Web checks of home lab services (blackbox-http job, probe=homelab in deploy/monitoring/prometheus_momentum.yml). Plex: its /identity page.

panels.title: Synology NAS
panels.description: Volumes not normal: degraded, crashed, or busy (sync, scrub, expand). Disks not normal: status or health other than normal. Update: DSM update waiting.

targets.expr: (max by (nas) (systemStatus{job="synology"})) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(max by (nas) (100 * (1 - raidFreeSize{job="synology"} / raidTotalSize{job="synology"}))) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(count by (nas) (raidStatus{job="synology"} != 1) or max by (nas) (systemStatus{job="synology"}) * 0) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

((count by (nas) ((max by (nas, diskID) (diskStatus{job="synology"} != bool 1) + max by (nas, diskID) (diskHealthStatus{job="synology"} != bool 1)) > 0)) or max by (nas) (systemStatus{job="synology"}) * 0) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(max by (nas) (temperature{job="synology"})) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(max by (nas) (diskTemperature{job="synology"})) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(max by (nas) (upgradeAvailable{job="synology"})) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(max by (nas) (100 - ssCpuIdle{job="synology"})) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(max by (nas) (100 * (1 - (memAvailReal{job="synology"} + memBuffer{job="synology"} + memCached{job="synology"}) / memTotalReal{job="synology"}))) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))

(max by (nas) (hrSystemUptime{job="synology"}) / 100) * on (nas) group_left (modelName, version) (max by (nas, modelName) (modelName{job="synology"}) * on (nas) group_left (version) max by (nas, version) (version{job="synology"}))
